_comment: Which preflight issue categories your Switch flow can fix automatically. Keys are categories from src/switch_mcp/knowledge.py. route_to = name of the checkpoint's outgoing connection that leads to the auto-fix branch; action_list = what that branch runs (for people reading the plan); needs_review = check the result on a proof. Copy to ~/.config/enfocus-switch-mcp/autofix_map.json, edit, and set SWITCH_AUTOFIX_MAP. Keys starting with _ are ignored.

registration_black.action_list: Registration and rich black text to 100K
